description:
Recognizes bird vocalizations in audio recordings.

Chirpity is your ultimate companion for identifying bird vocalisations. Designed with Nocmig enthusiasts and bioacoustic researchers in mind, Chirpity revolutionises the process of reviewing extensive audio files for the presence of avian sounds. Powered by cutting-edge Machine Learning, Chirpity offers the choice between the well-known BirdNET and a bespoke Nocmig model - finely tuned for Nocturnal Flight Calls - ensuring identification tailored to your specific needs. With intuitive features for reviewing, tagging, and organizing detected calls, Chirpity saves valuable time and effort.
What's new
- Multichannel support
  - Stereo audio is played back in stereo
  - All exported files will have the original sample rate and channel count by default, even when converting formats
  - For members, the spectrogram can show a split channel view.
- If file metadata overrides the default location, this is noted when the included species list is shown
Bug fixes
- Various minor bug fixes
Chores
- Patch Electron security vulnerability
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Mattk70/Chirpity-Electron/compare/v6.1.3...v6.2.0
